thesis: WMG has a clean uptrend (close above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200) and the market looked through the Nov 19 EPS shortfall: it reversed from a 30.7 intraday low to close higher on record revenue, with Morgan Stanley reiterating it as a top pick. AI licensing and streaming price floors give a structural narrative, and there is no earnings event, offering or M&A overhang for roughly 49 trading days. The case is only a pullback buy in the 31.8-32.4 zone, preferably the lower half, because reward/risk is 1.61 from mid and about 1.0 at the top of the zone. The setup is modest, and the risk-off regime (VIX 31.34, QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages) plus heavy leverage argue for small size or waiting.
